name: Novice des contenants
design: Young adult female alien, tall slim upright build and medium wide domed skull with silver-grey speckling, shoulder-length thick tendrils in evenly spaced plain bands. Four external mandibles around inner mouth. Coarse charcoal tunic with narrow long sleeves and a rough red rectangular waist panel, brown calf trousers. One hand grips a tiny plain cylindrical corked water flask, other hand supports a closed small wicker container at opposite hip. Claws exposed through plain foot wraps; no advanced kit.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE newly designed individual full-body 2D game sprite for Yautja: La Longue Chasse, HOMEWORLD APPRENTICE, a young ADULT novice (clearly adult proportions, not a child). Reference1 (Stan Winston 1987 close-up) has ABSOLUTE PRIORITY for anatomy of ALL heads: broad tall domed reptilian cranium, deep heavy alien orbital ridges, thick cylindrical scalp tendrils, FOUR distinct EXTERNAL fleshy mandibular lobes around a clearly separate internal toothed mouth. Two upper cheek tusks and two longer lower mandibles curling upward; never two nasal tubes or two hanging tusks. No human nose, lips, ears, human face, human hair or makeup. Turn head in readable frontal three-quarter toward viewer with all four external appendages visible, jaw calmly slightly open, not a scream. Female individuals have equally alien Yautja four-mandible faces and modest functional garments, no human beauty features. Reference2 is an older role atlas, use ONLY bottom-row fourth character's simple charcoal tunic/red sash civilian apprentice clothing and realistic sprite rendering style, NEVER reproduce its flawed facial anatomy or other characters. A new distinct person per design: vary body silhouette, cranial proportions, scale mottling, thick tendril arrangement, garment construction, simple novice supplies and work pose. Simple practical cloth clothing with charcoal, brown and a muted red sash, little equipment, no elite armor, no advanced technology, no fantasy staff. Realistic handpainted high-detail 2D game sprite, slightly elevated three-quarter full body facing right; neutral diffuse illumination, not cartoon. ONE character with props only worn or hand-held. Actual transparent alpha background, no ground, cast shadow, atmosphere, halo, environment, photographic background or watermark. No image sheet, no extra subject, no written lettering. Do not reproduce source logo. Entire body with intact feet, head and all gear. AT LEAST 8% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON ALL FOUR SIDES; zoom out, character at most 80% canvas height.
